changelog: Recon is now a proper scouting card — pick a spot just past your vision and it lights up a 3x3 patch of the fog for the turn. Bannermen finally grow with your army: they rank up as the units around them fight, gaining survivability (no attack or speed), and at rank 5 their aura jumps to +3 damage / -2 taken. Drilling a Bannerman at camp now gives +HP/+DEF instead of a wasted attack. Big-map battles run smoother — the board only redraws the tiles that change and the glow effects are lighter on the GPU. Fixes: your HQ never starts boxed in by rock, the Walker Turret can be built even at troop cap and no longer counts as a casualty, deploying onto a hazard sets it off, the 'Hold the Center' waves work properly, and Barracks add +2 troop cap.
